repository: MeniBreak — parsimonious breakpoint panel for meningioma recurrence
purpose: Reproduce the MeniBreak report numbers from retained code, and let an external cohort apply the same breakpoint-panel method to its own SEG data.

provenance.historical_source_report: breakpoint_panel_word_tables_fixed.docx (dated 2026-08-04; title 'A parsimonious breakpoint panel for meningioma recurrence')
provenance.chatgpt_claim: REJECTED. No ChatGPT/OpenAI URL or identifier exists in any source file's metadata, properties, links, or bytes. The prior claim that the scripts lived only in a ChatGPT workspace was unsupported; the scripts and outputs were recovered from the drive and are shipped here.
provenance.verification: Every value below was read from the shipped CSV and matches MeniBreak.docx to the printed precision.

cohort.restricted_definition: primary tumour, gross-total resection, no prior/adjuvant/induced radiotherapy, non-angiomatous

modelling.window_selection: top-k chi-square windows chosen inside each TRAINING fold only
modelling.windows: 20 equal arm-relative bins per autosome arm; binary presence; min prevalence 20 tumours
modelling.restricted_cohort: broad out-of-fold scores transported to the restricted subset (no refitting)

analyses/02_discover_hotlist.py.produces: in-fold window discovery and consensus stability list

analyses/03_full_ladder.py.produces: the full model ladder (WHO -> enriched) in both cohorts

analyses/04_scna_plus_panel.py.produces: SCNA vs SCNA+panel discrimination and matched-sensitivity operating points

external_use.input: a generic SEG (sample_id, chromosome, start, end, event) + outcomes
external_use.tested_on: data/example (synthetic); verified to run end-to-end and recover the planted 1p window

reproduction_status.panel_ladder_and_windows: RETAINED CODE + OUTPUTS — regenerate with analyses/ on the institutional dataset (IRB-restricted, not shipped)
reproduction_status.external_validation: RETAINED — negative result; single external cohort

limitations: Internal validation only: not yet validated in an independent cohort of comparable copy-number resolution. One attempt on a methylation-derived cohort (GSE189521) degraded, but that is a resolution mismatch rather than a refutation (~11 breakpoints/sample vs ~97; window occupancy 3.7% vs 27.8%).
The restricted cohort has 22/37/43 events at 3/5/7y; its largest effects are its least precise.
Research use only. No claim of clinical utility or prospective validation.
